selection: model WAPE strictly below last_week selects model; otherwise retain last_week; mean4 comparison only
bias_rule: report separately; does not reverse WAPE selection
review: common weeks>=10 AND same sign>=8 AND aggregate Bias>=0.10 or <=-0.10; equality has no sign; common weeks<10 insufficient data

error_correction.allowed: implementation departures from frozen specification only, e.g. date filter or lag calculation
error_correction.forbidden: change specification, thresholds, candidate selection or interpretation rules after results
error_correction.preservation: preserve original run and results; corrected run in new directory, record cause, code diff, affected results and before/after metrics

shap: per-week actual model and inputs; native TreeSHAP contributions to raw prediction; clip-to-zero separately; no redesign after explanations
report: last4weeks sliced from original final predictions, no rerun
final_keys: save baseline-valid actual/lastweek/mean4 keys and SHA256 before training first model
